display_name: omp web developer (React/Next.js, headless Chromium via agent-browser)
notes: Same role, skills and browser layer as pi-web-dev (shared/browser/install.sh); only the omp payload differs.
agent-browser, npm and next run under node, so the npm/googlefonts providers (binaries: node) cover them; omp itself only needs bifrost/context7/langfuse.
Use localhost, not 127.0.0.1 (IPv4 loopback is swallowed in OpenShell).
Do not add --profile to launch_cmd: named profiles ignore PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR.
